title: Christmas Tree Cupcakes
description: These Christmas tree cupcakes have green frosting and can be decorated with colored sugars, sprinkles, or candies for a festive holiday dessert.
ingredients: 2 drops green food coloring, or as needed
0.25 cup sprinkles, colored sugar, or candies

steps.text: Spoon 1/2 cup vanilla frosting into a bowl. Spread a thin layer over the top of each cupcake with a knife. Refrigerate cupcakes for 30 minutes to make decorating easier.
Combine remaining 2 cups of vanilla frosting and green food coloring in a bowl; stir until frosting is uniformly green. Add more green food coloring, 1 drop at a time, if needed.

Transfer frosting to a piping bag. Working perpendicular to the top of each cupcake, pipe green frosting around the edge, working inwards in a circular motion to create a tree shape. Repeat with remaining cupcakes.
Decorate Christmas trees with sprinkles, colored sugar, or candies as the "ornaments" on the trees.

video.description: Watch how to make these easy and festive Christmas tree cupcakes, simply using green frosting and a piping bag. Then don't forget to trim your tree with your favorite decorations - try edible glitter, red jelly beans, silver dragees, and more. The result is a professional-looking cupcake that is as fun to decorate as it is delicious to eat!
